about_the_game:
🇬🇧 About this Demo

This demo gives you a hands-on preview of Figurine Shop Simulator, a first-person management game where you run your own miniature figurine store.

🛍️ In this demo, you can:

  • Set up your store layout using a basic selection of furniture and shelving (4–5 available types)

  • Order products and restock them using the in-game computer

  • Paint figurines to increase their value

  • Display figurines on shelves or showcase plates

  • Handle sales at the cash register

  • Explore the base figurine pack and one themed extension: the Zombie Pack

  • Try one type of shop extension (more are planned for the full game)

  • Hire a basic employee (cashier only)

🎮 The full game will feature additional mechanics like tournaments, advanced employees (for cleaning and inventory), more thematic expansions, mystery packs, and strategic board placement — but those are not included in this demo.

This version is designed to offer a solid overview of the game’s core loop and atmosphere. We welcome your feedback!



Figurine Shop Simulator is a first-person management simulation where every detail of your miniature shop comes to life.

Design your store to optimize customer flow and enhance their experience. Arrange figurines, create themed battle tables, decorate the space, and attract the most passionate collectors.

Order stock from your in-game computer, unpack shipments, paint your figurines to increase their value, and place them on shelves or demo boards.

Handle sales at the cash register, manage inventory, set your own prices based on rarity and market demand, and offer mystery packs to surprise your customers.

As you earn money, reinvest in your store: expand the space, unlock new licenses, host figurine tournaments, and become the ultimate destination for miniature enthusiasts.

In Figurine Shop Simulator, every decision matters. Will you turn your humble shop into the ultimate figurine haven?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: 🎲 Run your own miniature figurine shop! Buy, paint, and display models, set prices, manage sales, and expand your store. Tournaments, mystery boxes, rare collectibles, and community events… this is just the beginning!
